prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, sharply focused shot of a modern car’s dashboard display, featuring a high-resolution rearview camera interface. The central screen is divided into two main sections: on the left, a top-down, bird’s-eye view of a silver SUV navigating a narrow, rocky mountain path; on the right, a wide-angle rear camera view shows the rugged, uneven terrain with steep drop-offs and dusty, earth-toned rocks. Vivid green and red guide lines overlay the camera feed, indicating the vehicle’s projected path. The dashboard is sleek and contemporary, with metallic accents and tactile buttons labeled “MENU,” “AUDIO,” “CAMERA,” and “BACK,” as well as rotary dials for volume and tuning. The lighting is natural, suggesting daylight streaming through the car windows, illuminating the display with a soft, realistic glow. The color palette is dominated by neutral grays, silvers, and blacks, contrasted by the earthy browns and beiges of the rocky landscape on the screen. The overall style is clean, technical, and immersive, with a slight cinematic depth of field that keeps the focus on the display while subtly blurring the dashboard edges, evoking a sense of precision and modern automotive technology.
